title: Side bar: TV display and quick payment
summary: Control the waiting room screen and charge without leaving the screen you're on.

steps.title: Open the bar
steps.details: If it's closed, it's the little tab at the top right.

steps.title: TV control
steps.details: Status (on, paused, promo), each room's next patient and opening the screen. What you choose changes what's shown in the waiting room.

steps.title: Payment wizard
steps.details: Choose the patient, what to charge (quote, pending invoice or separate items), review the amounts and record the payment. It needs an open cash register.
